info.title: dotnet-heroes-data-parser
info.description: Extracts Heroes of the Storm game data into JSON format

commands.name: casc-extract
commands.description: Extract data files from a Heroes of the Storm directory or from online

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --storage-path
options.description:
Path to the Heroes of the Storm
directory

options.name: --download-ptr
options.description:
Download from the PTR server
instead of live (online
storage-type only)

options.name: --include-filter
options.description:
**/*       Glob pattern to include file
paths for extraction (can be
specified multiple times)

options.name: --exclude-filter
options.description:
Glob pattern to exclude file
paths from extraction (can be
the directory structure

options.name: --flatten
options.description:
Extract all files into a single
directory instead of preserving
the directory structure

options.name: --duplicates
options.description:
How to handle duplicate file
names (--flatten option only,
defaults to error)

options.name: --threads
options.description:
Number of threads for file
extraction (defaults to max
processors)

options.name: --http-timeout
options.description:
15         Timeout in seconds for HTTP
requests, 0 for infinite
timeout

options.name: --output-path
options.description:
Output directory for extracted
files (defaults to current
directory)

arguments.description: Storage type to load from (game or online)
